title: Radial Powered Mean Curvature Flow with Robin Boundary Conditions
summary: We study a positive radial graph evolving by $V=H^α+b$, with $α>0$ and $b<0$, in the unit cylinder and with $u_r(1,t)=u(1,t)$. We separate finite-time continuation estimates from the time-uniform interior estimates needed for convergence of normalized translates. On existing classical intervals we prove height and gradient bounds and an explicit conversion of velocity bounds into estimates for $H$, $u_r/r$, and $u_{rr}$.
